# ArtSpark

> ArtSpark — "Your Trusted Partner in Academic Excellence" — is a Sri Lankan study-consulting and academic writing-support service founded in 2024, for university and professional students in Sri Lanka and Sri Lankan students abroad.

Every writer is a graduate of a Sri Lankan government university and works only within their own faculty. Every order receives a fixed price and delivery time before payment, a free Turnitin similarity report and AI-detection report (plagiarism and AI text kept below 10%), and seven days of free revisions. Free quotes are given within 30 minutes on WhatsApp (+94 71 918 8867), 24 hours a day, in English and Sinhala.

## Services
- [Assignment writing](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#assignments): Coursework, essays and reports from diploma to MBA, written to your rubric and referencing style.
- [Thesis & dissertation](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#thesis): Proposal to final chapter, shaped round your supervisor's feedback, with viva preparation at the end.
- [Research & data analysis](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#research): Questionnaires, SPSS, Excel, R or NVivo analysis — with the output explained in plain words.
- [Journal articles & papers](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#articles): Research articles, review papers and conference abstracts prepared to the journal's author guidelines.
- [Presentations](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#presentations): Clear, well-designed PowerPoint or Google Slides decks built from your report, with speaker notes.
- [Case study analysis](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#case-studies): Applied analysis using the right framework — SWOT, PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces, VRIO and more.
- [Academic coaching](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#coaching): One-to-one online sessions on methods, statistics, academic writing and viva practice.
- [Editing & proofreading](https://artspark.edu.lk/services.html#editing): Grammar, flow, structure, referencing and similarity reduction on work you have already written.
